name: filter_string_methods
description: String methods on a keyword value: case conversion, substring and indexOf. Each one allocates, which is what makes string work in scripts expensive.

script.source: def v = doc['identified_content_language']; if (v.size() == 0) return true; String s = v.value.toUpperCase(); return s.substring(0, 1).indexOf('X') < 5;
